evidence_items.explanation: The same case-study report gives DeepInfra's cost per million tokens as $0.20 on Hopper and $0.10 on Blackwell, falling to $0.05 with NVFP4. These are reported monetary unit-cost reductions for adopters within the claim's scope; they do not establish company-wide profitability.
